cocoon.bigScreenDesc: Landscape + mirror/cast/HDMI when your OS supports it. Scaly Wings does not force HDMI output.
cocoon.bigScreenNote: Scaly Wings is big-screen ready when your device supports external display or screen mirroring. See docs/BIG_SCREEN_PLAYBOOK.md.
cocoon.bigScreenReady: Big-screen ready when your device supports it
bigScreenSteps: Rotate phone to landscape (optional but recommended).
Pair PS5/Xbox controller via Bluetooth or USB-C where supported.
Use Android DisplayPort/USB-C or iPhone external display/mirroring if hardware allows.
Open a game — controller or touch backup on phone.
